description.value: Pho Tru is a casual Vietnamese restaurant in Victoria that brings traditional street-side recipes to BC, with a menu built around pho noodle soups, Saigon subs, vermicelli bowls, and jasmine rice plates made fresh daily from generational recipes. The Mayfair location sits inside Mayfair Shopping Centre on Douglas Street, a natural waypoint for cyclists on one of Victoria's busiest arterials. Portions are noted by reviewers as filling, and the range of proteins and broths gives hungry riders plenty to choose from.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 52m; rack (3 spaces) at 52m; rack (3 spaces) at 55m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pho Tru is an active Vietnamese restaurant with two Victoria locations (Mayfair Shopping Centre at 3147 Douglas St, and Downtown at 1012 Blanshard St); the OSM node coordinates (48.4474831, -123.369068) fall within the Mayfair Shopping Centre vicinity, so the Mayfair address and phone are used here. The homepage explicitly lists 'Dine in . Pick Up . Delivery' confirming takeout, and the menu includes several vegetarian dishes (Tofu Salad Roll, veggie rice plate, PhoVegg). No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone. Address (3147 Douglas St) and phone (+1 778-433-9940) are inferred from the Mayfair location based on OSM node coordinates — verify before publishing.
A second Downtown location exists at 1012 Blanshard St, +1 250-590-7925; if the OSM node is ever found to correspond to the Downtown location, address and phone must be updated accordingly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-reviewed Vietnamese restaurant with dine-in and takeout; a solid meal stop for cyclists travelling along Douglas Street in Victoria.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Tofu Salad Roll (Goi Cuon Chay), a vegetable jasmine rice plate (tofu, broccoli, cauliflower, carrots with ginger lemongrass sauce), and a PhoVegg soup option
